vulnerability.name: USN-5261-1
vulnerability.description: It was discovered that Phusion Passenger incorrectly handled a file path in the application root folder. An attacker could possibly use this issue to read arbitrary files. (CVE-2017-16355)  It was discovered that Phusion Passenger had a race condition in the nginx module that could be used to perform a symlink attack. An attacker could possibly use this issue to escalate privileges. (CVE-2018-12029)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in Phusion Passenger. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
